privacy: Manual functional observations only. No account values, resume text, identifiers, cookies, tokens or raw traffic.

steps: Open the canonical homepage in the authorized Brave profile.
observed: Signed-in navigation links to dashboard, jobs, tracker and resume settings.
Public category links point to the jobs route.
Footer exposes FAQ, contact, privacy, refund, terms and help routes.

steps: Use the signed-in Dashboard navigation link.
observed: Application count, preference-completion indicator and a resume-backed job matches region.
Application status tabs and saved-only filtering.
Empty tracker state.
Autofill is explicitly marked incoming/unavailable.

steps: Wait for existing resume recommendations to render.
Open a visible match-percentage button.
Read Skills Match Analysis and close it.
observed: Recommendations include match percentage, matched skills, age, compensation and employer.
The explanation separates profile fit from keyword match.
Unassessed profile fit is displayed as not assessed, not as zero.
Skills are grouped into full and partial matches.
Save, Pass, View Details and Apply controls are present; no application was submitted.

steps: Open Find Jobs.
Open Search syntax help.
Dismiss help and open All Filters.
observed: Job-title/company text search, location combobox and suggested searches.
Help advertises uppercase AND and OR operators.
Remote/hybrid/on-site, office allowance, travel allowance/level, work schedule, employment type, experience, education, posted age, quick apply and visa sponsorship controls.
Annual/hourly salary unit, minimum salary and salary-known-only toggle.
Filter Apply, Cancel and Reset controls.

steps: Search for a job title.
Apply Remote and inspect results.
Set hourly minimum salary to 30 and apply.
Read settled result state and URL.
Clear all filters.
observed: Text search returns results with card and focus view options.
Focus view shows a job description, original-posting handoff and resume-match analysis entry point.
Remote filtering changes results and creates a removable chip.
Entering a positive minimum automatically enables salary-required.
Hourly salary criteria are reflected in the URL and chips; sampled visible cards have hourly ranges.
Transient loading retains the previously selected detail until new data settles.
A hyphenated test query containing real words returned word matches; no exact-match semantics inferred.

steps: Submit a random alphabetic query with no expected job match.
Wait for the visible result state to settle.
observed: The UI reports zero jobs and a No Jobs Found state.
The detail panel asks the user to select a job.

steps: Save one previously unsaved job from search.
Navigate to the job tracker and read the settled list.
Enable Saved only and open Recently Viewed.
Return to All, unsave the temporary bookmark and disable Saved only.
Verify the tracker returns to its initial empty state.
observed: A saved search result persisted across navigation into the tracker.
The saved row is explicitly labeled saved, not applied; Applied remains zero.
Status tabs, saved filtering and a separate recently viewed list are present.
Saved-only filtering is disabled with an explanation in Recently Viewed.
The footer counted a saved-only row as an application, despite the row distinguishing saved from applied.
The temporary bookmark was removed and the tracker returned to empty.

steps: Open Base Resumes and the existing resume viewer, then close it.
Open Upload New Resume and cancel.
Open Job-Optimized Resumes and Create Optimized Resume.
observed: Base resume cards have update timestamps, primary selection, viewing, deletion and match-to-job entry points.
The existing resume viewer opens.
Upload advertises PDF, DOC, DOCX, RTF and ODT with a 10 MB limit; name and file are required.
The optimized-resume list has an empty state and creation entry point.
Creation requires a base resume, company, job title, application URL and job description.
The form states a cover letter is generated with the optimized resume; generation remains unexercised.

steps: Open Job Preferences from Job & Resume Settings.
Inspect field labels and controls without saving changes.
observed: Role and target-location selection with removable selections.
Yearly/hourly minimum salary controls.
Benefit choices, remote/on-site/hybrid preferences, experience levels, education and work schedules.
Save control is present.
The route name contains job-alerts, but no notification frequency, delivery or schedule was evidenced in this form.

steps: Open Account Info and inspect Edit Profile, then cancel.
Open Notifications and Subscription.
Follow Choose a plan to the upgrade page without continuing to checkout.
observed: Profile editing exposes contact, location, photo and professional-link fields.
A change-password entry point is present.
Notifications expose email/SMS switches for platform news and job-match alerts, linked to job preferences.
Subscription has current-plan, payment-method and billing-history sections.
Upgrade advertises paid plans and renewal conditions; no purchase or subscription change was made.

steps: Visit the footer-linked FAQ, contact, help, privacy, terms, money-back and review routes.
Follow the optimized-list Job Search link target /remote-jobs.
observed: FAQ, contact form and support information are reachable; no message was sent.
Privacy copy describes access, correction, deletion and portability rights; no self-service export/delete workflow was found in the inspected account screens.
The upgrade page advertises a 14-day guarantee while the separate money-back page states a 7-day request window. This is a visible content inconsistency, not a verified refund outcome.
The /remote-jobs link resolves to /jobs.
Review/testimonial content was viewed as a public claim, not independent validation.

steps: Open a recommendation through its View details link; follow the new tab.
Read the existing match explanation summary.
Open More actions > Report, inspect reasons and cancel.
Use View original posting, inspect the employer listing and close that new tab.
Return to Job Tracker and inspect the application count.
observed: Job detail shows existing resume-match percentage and full/partial/missing skill counts.
An optimize-resume action is available; it was not invoked.
Report reasons include scam, recruiter, misleading, expired, duplicate, spam and other.
The original-posting control opened a matching listing on the employer's Workday origin.
No employer form was filled or application submitted.
Company information and a website link are present.

steps: Set a temporary 390 by 844 viewport.
Switch Job Description to Company Info.
Open and close the mobile navigation.
Restore the default viewport.
observed: The mobile layout exposes separate description/company tabs and an expandable navigation menu.
The company tab changes the selected section.
The sampled document width did not exceed the viewport width.
Visible loading states were observed in search, tracker and resume lists.
Escape dismissed tested help/select overlays; no exhaustive keyboard or accessibility certification was performed.
Viewing an original employer posting left the tracker Applied count at zero.
